_note: Global site config and outbound links.
_canonicalDomain_note: Primary domain. jmccjmsb.ca is legacy and 301s here. Mirrors astro.config.mjs `site` — that config is the source of truth for generated URLs; this value is for copy and docs.
_incidentFormUrl_note: Google Form embed URLs (the .../viewform?embedded=true form). Until set, /report renders a 'not yet available' state with the VP Internal's email — never a blank iframe. If only one Form exists, put the same URL in both.
_incidentFormAnonymous_note: null = unverified, so /report makes NO anonymity claim. Set true ONLY after confirming on the Form itself that 'Restrict to users in your organization', 'Collect email addresses', and 'Limit to 1 response' are all OFF. Set false if any cannot be turned off.
_blogPublic_note: false = blog built but unlisted, noindexed, excluded from sitemap and nav. Flip to true to revive publicly.
_signupUrl_note: Active delegate sign-up form. Until supplied, the Get Involved CTA renders disabled with a 'Applications opening soon' state — never a dead link.
